guitar.modelsText: Gibson ES-355 / Les Paul / PRS / Hentor Sportscaster
guitar.evidence: Alex Lifeson's gear evolved a lot over Rush's career (Gibson ES-355 in early years, then Les Pauls, then signature PRS models); medium confidence is appropriate given the variety.

tone.target: bright Geddy-style chorus delay clean-crunch with rhythmic shimmer
tone.profile: bright Geddy-style chorus delay clean-crunch with rhythmic shimmer
tone.summary: A clean signal chain utilizing compression and a light OD boost into an AC30-style amp, enhanced by Chorus and Digital Delay to achieve the required 'Spirit of Radio' shimmer.
corrections: keep gain lighter than rock crunch
